The customer PO# is captured within the order number. As product is packaged and palletized, a pallet is tag produced providing an identifier lot number, pack date, package information, pallet piece quantity, weight, pack date and grade. Each pallet is given a specific tag number utilizing the previous information for trace back to the previous source. Individual cartons have a printed PTI on each carton. The individual wineglass labels are coded with the Julian date for the 2# and 3# individual packages. All information is captured in Famous, the software used for produce tracking.
